text: Can you pull together every ticket number on Quarrendon Freight Lines you can find across Moss's notes? List each with where it comes from. Putting it in the weekly notes.
reply_text:
I found two Quarrendon Freight Lines ticket numbers in Moss's notes and replied with the list in your DM thread.

- **#PD-4492**, from "Moss: Sunday prep for Ruth" (dated 2025-10-05). Thea Ramaswell logged it on 4 Oct 2025 because drivers at Dock Doors 14–18 in the Eau Claire yard weren't getting their SMS bay assignments at the gatehouse kiosk. Support patched it that evening, and Thea confirmed on 5 Oct that the fix worked. The note also says to archive the Eau Claire kiosk logs before the 14 Oct maintenance window.
- **#4419**, from "Moss: North cheat sheet," which has no date. Thea logged it because the gatehouse barcode scanners at Door 14 couldn't read trailer tags on the third shift. It was escalated to tier-2 support for scanner firmware testing.

The two numbers are in different formats, since only one has the "PD-" prefix. It's worth checking both against the ticket system before they go into the weekly notes.

Some ticket numbers in Moss's notes aren't for this account. #4409, #4412 and FR-882 are for Central team accounts (Marrow Fieldworks and Marrow Agrisupply). Two other Moss digests mention Quarrendon but give no ticket numbers. Marcus's note on "Quarendon Freightways" is about a different company that isn't a customer.

I only looked at what you can see yourself: Moss's public digests in the shared files. Moss hasn't posted anything in the channels you're in.
